name: SHOPLINE
description:
The SHOPLINE connector lets you manage your SHOPLINE store directly from Claude. Once connected, you can create and update products, look up order details, 
check inventory levels across locations, and manage collections — all through 
natural language, without switching to the SHOPLINE admin dashboard.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SHOPLINE to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SHOPLINE to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://setup.shopline.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SHOPLINE MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SHOPLINE provides these MCP tools: createCustomCollection, createProduct, getCollection, getInventoryLevels, getLocations, getOrders, getProduct, getProducts, getShop, searchShoplineDocs, setInventoryLevel, and updateProduct.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SHOPLINE?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SHOPLINE in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
SHOPLINE requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SHOPLINE is developed by SHOPLINE. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
